system.description:
A seminal Hermetic art of the earliest Tremere, Alchemy reshapes raw elements toward their ideal forms. With Conforma the thaumaturge coaxes a substance into a new shape without changing what it is.

Conforma performs simple changes in form, such as separating water into amorphous clouds of hydrogen and oxygen or drawing a liquid into a desired shape of solid, though the element itself remains the same. You must know every element involved (at least two levels of Science or Science: Chemistry) and work in a laboratory setting. The process takes one hour per level of Alchemy, ending in a Static Mental Challenge at the Storyteller's discretion. Retest with Science.
